product.title: Pachacamac's Inka Pyramids Tour including Museum Small-Group

description.text: In Lima, this small-group half-day heads south to Pachacamac for the site museum and the Temple of the Sun. Air-conditioned private transport, a professional guide, bottled water, and entry tickets are included, with the group capped at 10. The published route stays on the adobe sanctuary and museum rather than adding Barranco or a historic-center walk. Round-trip pickup from Lima is listed when booking. The format suits visitors who want a guided Indigenous sanctuary window without buying tickets and arranging the desert-coast transfer independently. Shade is limited on the adobe terraces, so sun protection is useful on the published walk. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Lima, and the itinerary stays on the Pachacamac Site Museum and Temple of the Sun that define this outing rather than a Caral valley day.
